crossRefs.note: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward…

parallels.note: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.
translations.bsb: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
translations.kjv: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
translations.asv: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
